title: Week of 13–19 July
summary: Margaret's sleep and appetite both worsened this week. She saw Dr Aziz on Friday, who took bloods, stopped the amlodipine and booked a review for 31 July.

sections.heading: Sleep
sections.body_markdown: Margaret was up several times overnight on three occasions this week [E1], against a four-week average of one night a week. Sarah stayed over on Tuesday and described her coming downstairs twice.

citations.title: Poor sleep, up four times overnight

sections.heading: Appetite
sections.body_markdown: Two meals were refused or left largely uneaten [E2]. This is the fourth week running in which appetite has come up, and the first in which two family members reported it independently.

citations.title: Off her food, refused her tea

sections.heading: Medication and appointments
sections.body_markdown: Dr Aziz stopped the amlodipine at Friday's appointment [E3], on the view that it was behind the dizziness that started in mid-June [E4]. One evening dose of apixaban was missed on Saturday [E5] — the second missed dose in nine weeks.

questions_for_the_doctor: Now the amlodipine has stopped, how long before the dizziness should settle?
Is the poor appetite worth investigating separately, or is it likely to be the same picture?
watch_items: Appetite — four mentions of skipped or refused meals this month
Missed evening apixaban doses — two in nine weeks, both on a Saturday
data_gaps: No blood pressure readings recorded since the surgery rang in April
No weight recorded at any point

title: Week of 6–12 July
summary: A quieter week. One missed chiropody appointment and a continuing thread about appetite.

sections.heading: Appetite
sections.body_markdown: Priya reported Margaret eating half a sandwich and nothing else [E1]. This is the third week appetite has been mentioned.

citations.title: Off her food, ate half a sandwich

sections.heading: Missed appointment
sections.body_markdown: The home chiropody visit was missed [E2]: Margaret did not answer the door and had no memory of the appointment. It has not yet been rebooked.

watch_items: Appointments Margaret is not reminded about are being missed
data_gaps: No record of what the carers log at the morning visits
